name: cfg-router-token-saver
about: router.tokenSaver（parseRouterConfig.ts:318-520；router/tokenSaver/classifyAndRoute.ts、generateJudgePrompt.ts、parseTier.ts）：judge 指定判档模型；tiers 两档各给 model / label / description；defaultTier=simple；rules 附加到判档提示；judgeTimeoutMs=600（最小 500）。同一会话先判 simple 再判 complex（第二次提示带上一档），另一会话判档请求挂 1.5 秒超时、三次后回落缺省档，再一会话判档回复无法解析、三次后回落。用 serve 起服务，比较 stdout 里的 [token-saver] 日志、判档请求体、各轮落到的模型、router/events.jsonl。cacheAwareSwitching.enabled=false 关掉缓存感知切换；subagent.policy=skip。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        judge:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        cheap:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        big:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
router:
  enabled: true
  tokenSaver:
    enabled: true
    judge: bbx/judge
    defaultTier: simple
    judgeTimeoutMs: 600
    rules:
      - Prefer simple for greetings.
      - Use complex for refactors.
    subagent:
      policy: skip
    cacheAwareSwitching:
      enabled: false
    tiers:
      simple:
        model: bbx/cheap
        label: Cheap tier
        description: quick answers
      complex:
        model: bbx/big
        label: Big tier
